_comment: THE FLOOR ONLY RISES — see scripts/check-test-floor.mjs. It was LOWERED once, on 2026-08-23,
from 1369 to 1366, and this note is the reason it is allowed to have happened at all.
The five cases of eslint-rules/__tests__/no-forgeable-tier-in-gate.test.mjs were DELETED with the
rule they probed. pleks/no-forgeable-tier-in-gate banned importing lib/tier/getOrgTierFromCookie;
the CD ruling on M-092 removed `tier` from getServerOrgMembership's return, which reduced that
module to a one-line alias, so it was deleted and the rule had no subject left. Its replacement,
assertion is a @ts-expect-error checked by tsc, which vitest cannot count). Net -3.
THE DISTINCTION THAT MAKES THIS LEGITIMATE, and the only one that does: the check's own error
says 'find what stopped collecting'. That was done — the tests did not stop collecting, they
stopped existing, deliberately, in a commit that says so. Padding the replacement suite with
three filler cases to hold the number would have been the dishonest fix: it satisfies the
counter while making the suite worse, which is the shape this whole ratchet exists to prevent.
A DROP WITH NO ENTRY HERE IS STILL A FINDING. If the floor falls again, the burden is to name the
deleted suite and the commit that deleted it, in this file, before touching the number.
